skill.name: ai-maestro-documentation-search
skill.description: Search AI Maestro generated documentation before implementation to find function signatures, API notes, class details, and code comments.
skill.summary: Search project documentation before coding so agents use known APIs and patterns.
skill.author: 23blocks-OS

security_audit.summary: Most static command findings are Markdown examples for local documentation tools, not executable backtick code. The review confirmed risk in the relative installer instruction and found overbroad prompt-control language that can drive unsolicited Bash use. No evidence found of external data exfiltration or remote network access beyond localhost.

remediation.issue: Relative installer command is not packaged with the skill.
remediation.suggestion: Remove ./install-docs-tools.sh or include a verified installer with explicit user confirmation and integrity checks.

remediation.issue: Skill text uses forceful global directives for every user task.
remediation.suggestion: Scope the behavior to documentation-related coding tasks and state that higher-priority instructions and user confirmation still apply.

remediation.issue: Bash commands are presented as automatic first steps.
remediation.suggestion: Require confirmation before indexing projects, installing tools, or running commands that inspect broad paths.

semantic_findings.title: Prompt Injection Attempt Detected
semantic_findings.description: SKILL.md uses forceful directives such as "THIS IS NOT OPTIONAL. THIS IS YOUR DEFAULT BEHAVIOR." and requires documentation searches for ANY user instruction. This can override normal task prioritization and trigger unsolicited Bash use.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The prose does not ask to skip security review, but it uses high-authority language and applies to every user instruction. That makes it a strong prompt-control risk in a community skill.

semantic_findings.title: Unpackaged Relative Installer Execution
semantic_findings.description: The skill instructs running ./install-docs-tools.sh, but the package file tree lists only SKILL.md. A relative installer command could execute an unrelated script in the current project directory.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The command is present in the skill text and the generated file_structure contains no installer script. The risk depends on workspace contents, but the relative execution pattern is clear.

content.value_statement: Developers lose time when agents guess APIs or duplicate existing code. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to search AI Maestro documentation before implementation.
actual_capabilities: Guides agents to search indexed AI Maestro documentation before coding.
Lists documentation commands for semantic search, keyword search, document lookup, and index statistics.
Maps common coding requests to relevant documentation search commands.
Describes supported document types such as functions, classes, modules, interfaces, components, constants, readmes, and guides.
Provides troubleshooting steps for missing scripts, empty indexes, and local AI Maestro connection issues.
limitations: Requires AI Maestro documentation tools to be installed separately.
Depends on an existing documentation index for useful results.
Does not include the referenced shell scripts in this package.
Uses Bash-oriented workflows, so command execution should be confirmed in sensitive projects.

use_cases.title: Check API Usage Before Editing
use_cases.description: Search for function signatures and documented behavior before changing service or controller code.

use_cases.title: Find Existing Patterns
use_cases.description: Look up classes, modules, and components before adding new implementations.

use_cases.title: Validate Documentation Coverage
use_cases.description: List indexed documents and inspect statistics before relying on generated documentation.

prompt_templates.title: Search for a Function
prompt_templates.prompt: Search the project documentation for the function I named, then summarize its parameters, return value, and common callers.

prompt_templates.title: Review an API Change
prompt_templates.prompt: Before editing this API, search documentation for related endpoints, service classes, and validation rules. Then propose the smallest safe change.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Existing Patterns
prompt_templates.prompt: Search documentation for similar modules and components. Compare their documented patterns before creating a new implementation plan.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Documentation Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Check documentation coverage, search for the affected domain, identify missing or stale entries, and recommend indexing or code review steps.

output_examples.input: Find documentation for the payment service before changing refund behavior.
output_examples.output: The agent reports matching payment service docs, summarizes refund method inputs, notes related validation rules, and lists files to inspect next.

output_examples.input: Implement authentication changes without checking docs.
output_examples.output: The agent first searches authentication documentation, summarizes known flows, and flags gaps before proposing implementation steps.

output_examples.input: Why are documentation search results empty?
output_examples.output: The agent checks index status, confirms whether documents exist, and suggests re-indexing the correct project path when needed.

best_practices: Search for exact names and broader concepts before editing code.
Confirm documentation freshness before relying on search results.
Review full documents after search results identify the best match.
anti_patterns: Running installer or indexing commands without user confirmation.
Assuming empty results mean no implementation exists.
Using documentation search as a replacement for reading affected source files.

faq.question: What does this skill help agents do?
faq.answer: It guides agents to search AI Maestro documentation before implementing code changes.

faq.question: Does this skill include the documentation search scripts?
faq.answer: No. It documents how to use expected AI Maestro command-line tools, but this package only contains SKILL.md.

faq.question: Can it work without indexed documentation?
faq.answer: It can show troubleshooting steps, but useful search results require an existing documentation index.

faq.question: Does it support Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Will it modify my project files?
faq.answer: The search guidance is read-oriented, but indexing and installer commands may inspect or modify local tool state.

faq.question: What should users verify before running it?
faq.answer: Users should verify the AI Maestro tools, confirm the project path, and approve any installation or indexing command.
